description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewayConnectionSecurity component of the openclaw project. It tests TLS fingerprint handling, auto-connection logic, and host-based port and TLS use decisions.

classes.name: GatewayConnectionSecurityTests
classes.description: A test suite for verifying the security and connection behavior of gateway connections, especially TLS fingerprint handling and auto-connect logic.

methods.name: makeController
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of GatewayConnectionController for testing purposes.

methods.name: makeDiscoveredGateway
methods.description: Constructs a GatewayDiscoveryModel.DiscoveredGateway instance with specified parameters for testing.

methods.name: clearTLSFingerprint
methods.description: Clears stored TLS fingerprint for a given stableID.

methods.name: discoveredTLSParams_prefersStoredPinOverAdvertisedTXT
methods.description: Tests that the TLS parameters preferring stored fingerprint take precedence over advertised TXT records.

methods.name: discoveredTLSParams_doesNotTrustAdvertisedFingerprint
methods.description: Tests that the system does not trust the advertised fingerprint if no stored fingerprint exists.

methods.name: autoconnectRequiresStoredPinForDiscoveredGateways
methods.description: Checks that auto-connecting to discovered gateways requires stored PINs.

methods.name: manualConnectionsForceTLSForNonLoopbackHosts
methods.description: Verifies that manual connections enforce TLS for non-loopback hosts.

methods.name: manualDefaultPortUses443OnlyForTailnetTLSHosts
methods.description: Ensures default port selection logic uses port 443 only for certain hostnames.

methods.name: clearAllTLSFingerprints_removesStoredPins
methods.description: Confirms that clearing all stored fingerprints removes all PINs.
